newsitem.title: FINLAND: CS FIRST BOSTON HAS "BUY" ON RAISIO .
newsitem.headline: CS FIRST BOSTON HAS "BUY" ON RAISIO .

text.p: CS First Boston has a "buy" recommendation for Finnish food, animal feeds and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy, maker of Benecol cholesterol-cutting margarine the investment bank said in a note dated October 29.

"The details released in the Benecol progress report more than match our original assumptions," CS First Boston said, referring to an announcement last week. But it did not specify its earlier recommendation for the company.
